FFmpeg bundled with Layerbase Sequence Player
=============================================

ffmpeg.exe in this folder is an unmodified copy of FFmpeg, a separate program
that Layerbase Sequence Player runs to encode movies (H.264, H.265, ProRes).
It is not part of Layerbase Sequence Player and is not covered by its license.

Version      FFmpeg n8.1.3 (build n8.1.3-20260925), Windows x64, static, GPL
Build        BtbN FFmpeg-Builds, release "autobuild-2026-09-25-15-37"
             file ffmpeg-n8.1.3-win64-gpl-8.1.zip
             https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/tag/autobuild-2026-09-25-15-37
License      GNU General Public License version 3 (see FFMPEG_LICENSE.txt).
             FFmpeg is licensed under the LGPL/GPL; this build includes GPL
             components such as x264 and x265, so the build as a whole is GPLv3.
SHA-256      96D0DD139BA60446F8DDE48B42ED1D0BA65D30AED3A1B7D953FAFE6E0EAE58A7

Source code
  FFmpeg source for this version:
    https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.3.tar.xz
    https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n8.1.3
  Build scripts, including the exact versions of every library in the build:
    https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds (tag autobuild-2026-09-25-15-37)

  Layerbase Luxury Vision will also provide the complete corresponding source
  code of this FFmpeg build on request, for at least three years after the last
  distribution of this version, free of charge except for the cost of the
  medium: https://layerbase.it

You can replace ffmpeg.exe with any other FFmpeg build: Layerbase Sequence
Player uses the ffmpeg.exe next to its executable, or the one set in Settings.

FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard, originator of the FFmpeg project.
